entities.name: Josue Dupon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josuë Dupon was a Belgian sculptor. He was born in Ichtegem and died in Antwerp. In 1936, he was posthumously awarded with a bronze medal in the art competitions of the Olympic Games for his "Equestrian Medals".
